_doc: Phone calls (plugins/phone-call). provider: the voice-agent service a call uses unless --provider says otherwise (vapi or elevenlabs). owner_number: the user's own phone (E.164), where a hold call connects them. model: the Claude model on the call; empty means the installation's pinned Haiku. voice.voice_id / voice.model: the ElevenLabs voice both providers speak with (same on both, so they can be compared). monthly_budget_usd: new calls stop once a calendar month's calls cost this much; the system channel hears at 80%. max_task_minutes / max_hold_minutes: how long a call may last (hold at most 115). vapi.phone_number_id: the calling number as imported into Vapi (phone-call setup vapi). vapi.optimize_streaming_latency: 0-4, higher answers sooner and sounds less natural. elevenlabs.agent_id / elevenlabs.phone_number_id: from phone-call setup elevenlabs.
